text:
Ana Patel: FYI promote is blocked by ci/smoke-docker-image-extract. Several staging runners failed while unpacking the image layers. deploy-bot flagged the candidate.
Tom Nguyen: saw it. errors look like: 
```
Tar error: unexpected EOF while reading tar header
extractor: failed to unpack layer sha256:abcde...: io: read/write on closed pipe
```
Kyle R.: Any chance this is a transient registry/network hiccup vs corrupted image?
Tom Nguyen: initial artifact publish logs show successful upload and digest matches. registry returns 200 on head. suspect runner cache/local overlayfs issues.
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked for release r2026.03.29 (candidate: sha-def456). Reason: ci/smoke-docker-image-extract failed (layer-unpack-error).
Release Manager: We have three options: 1) retry CI job (cheap), 2) force promote to last-green (sha-def440) with a postmortem, 3) hold until we fully investigate. What's the impact?
Ana Patel: If we hold, cut will miss today's change window. I'd rather retry with fresh runners and collector disabled.
Infra Oncall: There's been a spike in runner ephemeral-disk IO errors earlier today (rz-io-6). Could be correlated. Recommend spinning new runner pool and retesting once fresh nodes online.
Tom Nguyen: I'll trigger a rerun on fresh pool: `/rerun ci/smoke-docker-image-extract --pool=fresh-ephemeral --build=2026-03-29-rc2`
ci-bot: Job queued: ci/smoke-docker-image-extract (build 2026-03-29-rc2) on pool fresh-ephemeral. ETA 4m.
Tom Nguyen: Also adding a step to verify image digest locally before extract: `docker pull ${IMAGE}@${DIGEST} && docker image inspect ${DIGEST}` to fail fast on corrupt registry blobs.
ci-bot: Rerun completed: ci/smoke-docker-image-extract (build 2026-03-29-rc2) - FAILED. Same unpack error on two runners.
Kyle R.: Hmm. Both runners in different AZs. Not likely local disk. Can we check registry storage nodes health and blobstore GC?
Infra Oncall: Checking registry nodes... noticed several 503s around 03:12Z from storage backend during blob fetch; also garbage-collector job was running. Looks like concurrent GC may have evicted in-flight blobs. I've paused GC.
Tom Nguyen: Good catch. Can we retry once GC pause propagates?
Ana Patel: agree. But if retry fails again, we should pin to last-green and open incident for registry blob GC interfering with publishes. Release Manager?
Release Manager: If next rerun fails, pin to sha-def440 and create ticket INF-2304 referencing this thread and registry logs. Manual promote requires `release:promote --candidate=sha-def440 --ticket=INF-2304`. We need +1 from infra oncall.
ci-bot: Rerun queued: ci/smoke-docker-image-extract (build 2026-03-29-rc3).
ci-bot: Rerun completed: ci/smoke-docker-image-extract (build 2026-03-29-rc3) - PASSED. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Promotion unblocked for r2026.03.29 (candidate: sha-def456).
Ana Patel: Great. No pin needed. Please add a note to the release: "Transient registry GC interference caused image layer unpack failures on CI; GC paused during publish window; follow-up: ensure GC excludes recent publishes (INF-2304)."
Release Manager: Adding note and linking job ids + registry logs. Also scheduling a postmortem with infra for tomorrow.
Kyle R.: Filed INF-2304 to track changes to GC behavior and runner health checks.
Ana Patel: Thanks everyone. Proceeding with promote. :white_check_mark:
